name: kentra-agentic-plugins
description: Kentra's branded catalog of agentic coding primitives, distributed as Claude Code plugins. The primitives themselves stay neutral (own repos, MIT); this catalog is the branded distribution layer — the distribution-axis sibling of the kentra-sdlc methodology umbrella.

plugins.name: adr-sourced-constitution
plugins.description: Bootstrap skill (constitution-init) for the adr-sourced-constitution primitive: interviews and scaffolds a project's constitution (event-sourced ADR log → deterministic constitution.md). Ongoing-governance skills are installed into the governed repo by `constitution init`, not bundled here.

plugins.name: spec-lifecycle
plugins.description: Bootstrap skill (lifecycle-init) for the spec-lifecycle primitive: installs the CLI and scaffolds a project for the staged, human-gated, spec-driven issue lifecycle (refine → design → plan → archive, OpenSpec on-disk format). Per-stage skills are installed into the governed repo by `lifecycle init`, not bundled here.

plugins.name: agent-orchestration-skills
plugins.description: Operator and consumer skills for the agent-orchestration module: launch/resume execute-change runs through the orchestrator daemon (orchestration-launch) and monitor live runs — status fold, classified death causes, dashboard/index surfaces (orchestration-monitor).

plugins.name: kentra-skills
plugins.description: Kentra skills: java-hexagonal (framework-neutral hexagonal / ports-and-adapters layering, ArchUnit shape enforcement, and a three-tier test strategy — unit / domain-with-fakes / Testcontainers) and kentra-workflow (an orchestrator/implementer/verifier subagent loop for executing a written implementation plan).
